mlag.note: Active/active MLAG pair using standard LACP (listed on the datasheet)

stacking.note: No hardware stacking on the datasheet. Arista SWAG (Switch Aggregation Group) can combine switches into one logical system over standard Ethernet links, but per-platform support is not published publicly

verifyNote: SWAG support is not on the datasheet and Arista's platform list is behind a login. If confirmed, set stacking.tech to SWAG and take the member limit and port usage from the platform documentation, not the general 48-switch figure

routing.summary: EOS Layer 3: static, OSPFv2/v3, IS-IS, BGP/MP-BGP, RIPv2, PIM, VRRP; VXLAN bridging with EVPN type 2. Dynamic routing and EVPN need the FLX-Lite license (Group 1)

power.summary: External 150W or 280W AC power adapter (280W ships with the -16P), or PoE-powered from an upstream 802.3bt switch through the PD port. Fanless

redundancy.detail: Single external adapter or PoE input; no redundant supply listed

licensing: Base EOS included. Dynamic routing, EVPN and VXLAN need FLX-Lite (LIC-FIX-G1-FLX-L). Also manageable with CloudVision CUE (subscription)
note: CCS-710P-12 (end of sale Mar 20, 2026, with listed replacements) is intentionally excluded

models.poweredBy: External 280W adapter (included) or 150W adapter, or up to 90W 802.3bt on the PD port
models.note: One of the two non-PoE 5G ports is the PD input; the datasheet lists it as PD/PSE. Magnetic and L-bracket mounts are also available
